pre_condition: proj_dir is an existing directory containing a fm_agent/ subdirectory. modified_functions is a non-empty dict mapping absolute source-file paths to per-file change records — each record being a dict keyed by change-class strings whose values are lists of bare function name strings (without class qualifiers, possibly with regex dedup suffixes like '_1', '_2'). classes is a tuple of strings identifying which change classes to process. For each source-file key in modified_functions, the derived extracted-function directory under proj_dir/fm_agent/extracted_functions/ exists and contains files from which bare method tails are resolvable.
post_condition: Returns a dict whose keys are fully-qualified function name (FQN) strings and whose values are absolute paths to the corresponding extracted function files. For each source-file path in modified_functions: only changes whose class is in classes are considered; for each bare name in those change lists, the name (or its stem with any trailing '_<digit>+' regex dedup suffix stripped) is matched against the bare method tails of extracted-function files in the derived directory. When a single bare name or stem matches multiple extracted files (same method name in different classes), all matching FQNs are included in the returned mapping — the result is a sound over-approximation of the changed function set. The returned dict is empty when no names from the specified classes resolve to any extracted file.
